text:
Type: slim black picture frame with mat
Use: displaying photos, prints or posters; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: narrow frame in a smooth black finish with a rounded profile, white mat board, clear glazing
Colors: black, white, light grey insert
Shape: tall rectangle with a very thin rounded edge, wide white mat around the picture, crisp corners, delicate and light visual weight
Feel: crisp, quiet, refined
Goes with: white walls, black metal, light or dark wood, monochrome prints; minimalist, modern or industrial rooms

product.name: MARIETORP
product.description: Can be hung horizontally or vertically to fit in the space available.
